reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: block_verification.rs:883-886 enforces epoch-dependent max_blobs_per_block check, but data_column_verification.rs:532-561 omits this entirely, only verifying array length consistency. SSZ accepts up to MaxBlobCommitmentsPerBlock=4096 (eth_spec.rs:436), while runtime limits are 6-20 blobs depending on epoch (chain_spec.rs:1942-1963). Attack path confirmed exploitable: attacker crafts data column with commitments.len() exceeding epoch limit, bypasses gossip validation, propagates network-wide causing resource exhaustion during KZG verification before eventual rejection at block import. Spec reference from 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json lines 227-242 explicitly requires 'kzg_commitments count must not exceed max_blobs_per_block for the sidecar's epoch.' Severity calibrated to Medium: affects single client implementation (Lighthouse) with estimated 15-25% network share, below High threshold (>33%) but above Medium threshold (>5%). Attack vector requires single malicious P2P packet (meets severity criteria). Resource exhaustion impact limited to computational cost of oversized KZG verification, not consensus-breaking.
